title: WorkAgreementType
description: A work agreement is an implicit or explicit 'agreement' between a worker and an Employer or Contractee Organization in which said worker agrees to perform duties and responsibilities for the organization in some capacity.

startWorkDate.description: Date of worker's planned day for start of work

endWorkDate.description: Date of worker's planned day for end of work

inceptionDate.description: The date on which the agreement (e.g., contract) starts.

terminationDate.description: The date on which the agreement (e.g., contract) ends.

probationaryDatePeriod.description: The start and end dates of a worker's probationary period or duration
